title: Habit Stacking
hook: New habits fail floating on their own. Tie them to something automatic.
statement: Attach new habits to ones you already have.
explainer: Old routines run on autopilot. Hook a new one on and borrow that momentum.
sop: Attach one new habit and score Attachment.
equation_example: Anchor 9 × Attachment 6 = 54. Strong anchor, loose attachment. Tighten it up.
question: Pick one morning habit. Attach something new starting tomorrow.
closing_statement: New habits borrow strength from old ones.

Principle Nº 137: Habit Stacking

Attach new habits to ones you already have.
